claim: UKMTO or JMIC reports at least one attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, armed hostile approach, boarding or seizure involving a merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, the Persian Gulf, the Gulf of Oman or the Arabian Sea that took place on Sunday 29 November 2026 (00:00–23:59 Gulf time).

runs.scenario: If UKMTO reports an unexplained explosion several nautical miles from a merchant vessel, but does not say it was close to or directed at the vessel, one reader may count it as a nearby explosion while another may not. The criterion gives no distance threshold for 'close.'
runs.yes_requires: At least one qualifying incident involving a merchant vessel must occur on 29 November 2026 Gulf Standard Time (UTC+4) in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, or Arabian Sea, including waters around Socotra.
